sasha: Heads-up: saw a ~2.3x p95 latency spike on multi-variant routes when fallback from quantized-8bit -> fp16 happened. Happens intermittently around capacity bursts.

andrew: ugh. is that the compat-set that mixes q8hf and fp16?

sasha: yep. compat-set = {m-chat-q8, m-chat-fp16, m-chat-int8} routed by cost then latency. spike correlates with fallback-to-fp16 events.

mia: logs show a lot of kernel rebinds during those fallbacks. kernel selector is switching kernels mid-request, plus KV cache misses. paste: ```
[perf] kernel_switch=32 per_min, kv_miss=18% -> 47% during window, batch_size dropped 1.6 -> 1.1
```

zhou: so two problems: (1) fallback causes model variant mismatch -> cache key namespace differs -> KV cold. (2) scheduler splits batches because token_budget target is small for fp16 -> more fragmentation.

andrew: can you repro locally? what input distribution?

sasha: repro with synthetic burst (concurrent 120 req/s, avg prompt 48 tokens). script: ```bash
for i in {1..120}; do curl -s -H 'x-model: m-chat' -d '{"prompt":"lorem...","variant_hint":"q8hf"}' https://run/redwood/generate &
done
```

perf-bot: uploaded flamegraph: https://perf.internal/runs/1769991234/flame.html (shows kernel transition cost ~6ms per switch)

mia: also noticed batcher is doing per-variant penalty backoff: when compatset has >2 variants, batcher prefers strict per-variant grouping which increases queue-hold time. combined with token_budget=16 for that route we end up forming many tiny batches post-fallback.

zhou: proposal: try two changes in canary: (A) queue policy = "variant-affinity-relaxed" (allow 200ms cross-variant merge if kernel/tag-compatible), (B) dynamic token_budget target: lower to 8 for fp16 fallback windows, and (C) kernel sticky window = 1500ms to avoid rebind thrash.

andrew: +1. also suggest namespace-normalized KV keys where compatible variants share prefix so fallback doesn't cold-start cache. maybe add variant_alias mapping for shared KV.

sasha: good call. i'll add variant_alias for m-chat-*/shared-kv and roll canary to two pods in eu-west.

mia: quick A/B perf estimate from staging: baseline p95=132ms, after policy tweak p95=95ms, kv_miss down 47%->21%, throughput +12%. numbers noisy but promising.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: rollout/1769991234-compat-affinity-canary -> staging(2) then eu-west(2).

zhou: watch these metrics post-rollout: kernel_switch/s, kv_miss_ratio, batch_mean_size, p95, token_throughput. set alert if p95 > 150ms or kv_miss > 40%.

andrew: also add quick profiler capture (2s) when alert fires to S3 for triage.

sasha: I'll run the canary in 10m and post results. Thanks all. :rocket:
